title: Tests prove the refspec-form lease push allow entry passes a lane's own branch and refuses every other target
why: Owner chat 18:31 CST Nov 8 (via the coordinator, 18:31 CST): the owner pushes a refspec form of Own Branch Lease Push (`origin <src>:<branch>`) straight to main from a local session, with no tests of its own.
note: Blocked until the owner's four autoMode.allow entries are on main (steps lease-push-c-and-d and debt-classifier-lease-push close then). Cases to prove: a lease push of the lane's own branch through a refspec passes; a refspec whose target is main, another lane's branch, or an archive branch does not. The coordinator routes it once the entries land.
blockedBy: the owner's autoMode.allow push to main
